events.title: A Ghost in Your Ear
events.details: When an actor arrives late to a sound studio for a last-minute audiobook recording session, he is handed the script of a chilling ghost story to read. But as the engineer cues the recording and the evening wears on, the horrors slowly begin to escape the page to haunt the studio itself. Fresh from an acclaimed, sold-out run in London, A GHOST IN YOUR EAR is the "truly terrifying headphone horror" (The Guardian) from the darkly brilliant mind of Tony Award® nominee Jamie Armitage (SIX), made in collaboration with Ben and Max Ringham (ANNA, National Theatre). A mesmerizing blend of gothic horror and psychological thriller, this cutting-edge theatrical experience uses groundbreaking binaural sound technology to immerse every audience member in a haunting world of sound. And at Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre - one of New York's most intimate venues - there's no escaping the frights. Enter if you dare.

events.title: Alexa Tarantino Quartet
events.details: In the words of Wynton Marsalis, Alexa Tarantino is a !one-woman wrecking crew, [] an indomitable force for expression, education, and absolute excellence. The vibrant and versatile jazz saxophone s Critics Poll from 2020-2022, was named one of the Top 5 Alto Saxophonists of 2019 by the JazzTimes Critics Poll, and was one of 100 alumni to receive The Centennial Award from the Eastman School of Music (2022). Alexa !lights up rooms when she [plays] (JazzTimes). Her radiant spirit and artistry uplift and inspire her audiences one performance at a time. Alexa tours worldwide with Ccile McLorin Salvant, Wynton Marsalis and the Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra, and the Alexa Tarantino Quartet. Her records (Firefly, Clarity, Winds of Change) and compositions have consistently topped jazz radio charts, and her discography includes 25+ released recordings as a leader and sidewoman. Tarantino is in-demand internationally as an energetic and impactful clinician, mentor, and coach and also represents Jazz at Lincoln Center as a visiting educator for various programs with students of all ages and levels. She holds a masters degree in Jazz Studies from The Juilliard School and bachelors degrees in Jazz Saxophone Performance and Music Education with a certificate in Arts Leadership from the Eastman School of Music. Alexa is Founder and Artistic Director of the Cape Ann Jazz Workshop in Rockport, Massachusetts (est. 2014). events.title: Arianna Barricelli | Law of Attraction | Stephanie Webb | kittykat sailor
events.details: calling all the monsters to this incredible lineup's halloween show! This fabulous lineup is curated by Arianna Barricelli and her band, who are sure to bring down the house with their emotional lyrics and indie/alternative sound. Arianna Barricelli is bringing together a lineup that radiates the energy her band wants to show off the most; bittersweet, emotional lyrics, dancey/spooky halloween fun, and fabulous female fronted bands! Law of Attraction is a New York pop duo creating songs for late nights, loud speakers, and every moment in between. With honest lyrics and addictive melodies, they bring a fresh take on modern pop. Stephanie Webb is the bubbly, yet slightly off-putting, singer-songwriter of your witchy dreams. With her love for connection and cutting vulnerability, she invites you in to connect with her lyrics, yourself, or even a new friend. Inspired by every outspoken woman ever, she hopes you can find your own voice through the use of hers. Brooklyn-based band kittykat sailor leaves it all on the dancefloor. Genre blending bold dance-pop with bittersweet singer-songwriter ballads and a touch of country flair, kittykat sailor has a little something for everyone to get down to. costumes highly encouraged!
